ratings_why.fun: Gust is one clean idea a player gets at once, and crowning a favourite that the courtiers bow to is a board worth growing toward.
ratings_why.distinct: Defer and the Gale feeding the shop are fresh; the Gusts themselves are close to familiar extra-attack text.

verdict_why: One real readability fix: when "biggest" is checked mid-fight under Lady High Pressure; the rest reads well.

points.text: Lady High Pressure and Defer read "biggest" but don't say when; if the favourite takes damage mid-fight, another unit may become biggest and Defer flips. Say biggest is fixed at Start of Combat, or checked at each attack.

Five cards read the Gale at different thresholds (1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10). Naming the steps on the barometer (Fair, Change, Stormy) would make them readable at a glance and put the seed's barometer on screen.
The Helm's text (Defer plus a Shield) doesn't show the man who never leaves his fell and says his name to everyone; a version that stays in its slot or announces itself would carry the fantasy.
With Lord Mistral and Mistral Outrider together, one Outrider kill sets off two Gusts from two cards; worth showing both triggers on screen so the chain doesn't look random.
Old Föhn taking the blow for whoever Gusts is the best fit of fantasy and rule in the tribe; say what happens once he dies so the read stays clean.

standouts.why: Old Föhn, blamed for everything, literally takes the hits; the rule is the joke.
Lady High Pressure makes the whole court stand still while one favourite acts: precedence played, not named.
Sir Vane the herald announces who goes first; short, clear and on theme.

weakest.why: The Helm reads as a generic Shield giver; its name does the theme work.
The Sí Gaoithe is a high threshold check that hands out an item; the fairy host passing doesn't come through.
Pine-Cone Augur's low step is almost always met, so the first condition is noise on the card.

flags.note: When "biggest" is checked during the fight isn't stated, so who has Defer can change mid-fight.
Föhn with Lady High Pressure and The Swift Couriers may make a favourite that's very hard to kill.
Doubled Gale plus the mass Gust at 20 with a golden Thunderhead is a big in-fight spike.
